const report = $input.first().json; // Build HTML email const html = `

📊 LOOP Daily Performance Report

${report.report_date}

📈 Daily Summary

Total Deliveries
${report.summary.total_deliveries}
Completed
${report.summary.completed_deliveries}
Cancelled
${report.summary.cancelled_deliveries}
Avg Delivery Time
${Math.round(report.summary.average_delivery_time)} min
On-Time Rate
${report.summary.on_time_rate}%

🏆 Top Performers

${report.top_performers.map((p, i) => { const bonus = report.bonus_recommendations[i]; return ` `; }).join('')}
Courier Deliveries Rating Earnings Suggested Bonus
${p.name} ${p.deliveries} ⭐ ${p.rating.toFixed(1)} $${p.earnings.toFixed(2)} $${bonus.suggested_bonus}

Total Bonus Pool: $${report.total_bonus_pool}

${report.needs_improvement.length > 0 ? `

⚠️ Needs Improvement

${report.needs_improvement.map(c => ` `).join('')}
Courier Rating Deliveries Issue
${c.name} ⭐ ${c.rating.toFixed(1)} ${c.deliveries} ${c.issues}
` : ''}

Generated automatically by LOOP n8n Performance Report

${report.generated_at}

`; return { json: { to: process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL || 'admin@loop.com', subject: `📊 LOOP Daily Performance Report - ${report.report_date}`, html: html, report_summary: `${report.summary.completed_deliveries} deliveries, ${report.on_time_rate}% on-time` } };
